messages:
eli: FYI found a partner token in an archived ingest blob (gz) while investigating a customer debug. looks like 'Stashlink' style token, maybe long-lived.
maya: can you paste a sanitized snippet and the object path?
eli: path: gs://partner-archive/2026/03/21/ingest-20260321.gz, snippet: `Authorization: Stashlink st_abcREDACTEDxyz`
raj: that prefix usually indicates long-lived. partner claims daily rotation but this token doesn't match their rotating patterns.
ops_oncall: i'll start a scrub plan, advise on preserve vs destroy for compliance.
maya: immediate actions: 1) request partner to revoke the token, 2) scrub/redact archived blobs, 3) search internal vault and CI for token occurrences, 4) rotate any KMS wrapping keys that encrypted credentials for legacy syncs.
eli: found two accesses from our legacy sync lambda (svc-sync-legacy@infra) at 03:12 and 03:17 UTC per audit. it likely used a wrapped blob in GCS.
raj: i'm pulling audit logs and will list any services that used the token. also propose creating a new short-lived role in Vault for partner integrations.
security_bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2145 (partner token in archived blob). Owner: eng-security.
ops_oncall: scrub dry-run commands:
```
# inspect
gsutil cp gs://partner-archive/2026/03/21/ingest-20260321.gz - | zgrep -n "st_" || true
# redact
python -c "import sys; print('redacted')" | gsutil cp - gs://partner-archive/2026/03/21/ingest-20260321.gz
```
ops_oncall: dry-run shows occurrences; scheduling overwrite in 10m after partner coordination.
maya: RBAC change: restrict bucket read to ingestion-sa and infra admin roles, deny legacy lambda. i'll open an infra PR for the deny rule and policy snapshot. set up an exception window for the scrub.
raj: KMS plan: create new key kms-us-west1/partner-rewrap-20260321, re-encrypt wrapped blob, and revoke old key grants to the legacy principal. update IAM and document in runbook.
eli: i'll run a grep across S3/GCS/DB dumps and CI history for `st_` to ensure no downstream leaks.
ops_oncall: running CI history check: `git grep -n "st_[A-Za-z0-9]" || true` and `git log --all -p | grep -E "\bst_[A-Za-z0-9]+"`. reporting back in 15m.
maya: enforce Vault change: deny creation of long-lived static secrets for external partners. require TTL <=1h and automatic rotation. i'll prepare policy and migration notes.
security_bot: Audit event: storage.objects.get by svc-sync-legacy@infra at 2026-03-21T03:12:07Z (object: ingest-20260321.gz).
raj: discovered two internal calls to the partner API using the token; both from sync jobs. they may have been caching the token in an encrypted file. we must rotate the wrapping key and rotate any derived credentials.
ops_oncall: scrub complete and partner revoked token. no CI history matches.
eli: next steps for postmortem: 1) confirm partner revocation + provide evidence, 2) overwrite/redact archived blobs, 3) rotate KMS wrapping keys and remove grants, 4) rotate any Vault roles that could mint derived tokens, 5) enforce RBAC on partner buckets, 6) update onboarding: require OAuth short-lived tokens or Vault integration, 7) 72h elevated monitoring of partner endpoints.
maya: i pushed RBAC PR draft and Vault policy change; tagging @raj for KMS key creation and @ops_oncall for lambda refactor to fetch secrets from Vault.
raj: i'll schedule the rewrap and update the runbook commands. example: `gcloud kms encrypt --location=us-west1 --keyring=partner --key=partner-rewrap-20260321 --plaintext-file=wrapped_blob.bin --ciphertext-file=wrapped_blob.enc` then replace object.
ops_oncall: lambda refactor plan: replace static blob read with Vault fetch via short-lived role and then delete legacy lambda or put deny policy. timeline: 6-12 hours to implement & test.
eli: thanks all. i'll compile the incident report and set reminders for the follow-ups. :thumbsup:
